title: Improved zero-free half-planes for the quasi-Riemann hypothesis
summary: Recently, a uniform $\frac{7}{8}$ zero-free half-plane for finite-order Hecke $L$-functions over $\mathbb Q(\sqrt{-3})$ and its transfer to Dirichlet $L$-functions was given by OpenAI in [Ope26a]. In its proof, there are several parameters $b=\frac{1}{8}, \ell=\frac{1}{6}$, and $κ$. In this paper, via varying $b$, $\ell$, and $κ$, following the same strategy, we slightly improve the bound $\frac{7}{8}=0.875$ to \[ B_{\mathrm{new}}=\frac{18ξ_{\mathrm{new}}+7}{18ξ_{\mathrm{new}}+9} =0.874957019420098946\ldots, \] where $ξ_{\mathrm{new}}$ is the unique root in $(0.38858,0.38859)$ of…
